verdict.rationale: Grok's core interface is natural language. The docs show conversational text generation, tool calling that turns prompts into actions (web search, code execution, custom functions), agentic attachment search triggered by plain requests, and Grok Build for agentic coding via API and CLI. However, the evidence does not show the xAI platform itself (keys, teams, billing, settings) being operated through natural-language commands; that is documented only through the programmatic Management API. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of the product/platform itself beyond model prompting, hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation of Grok Build CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
